caption: The drawing depicts a pair of knee-length undergarments, shown in a front-facing orientation. The garment is light in color, primarily rendered in shades of white and light blue, with blue shading used to convey the folds and contours of the fabric. The waistband is fitted and secured with a single button, and there are two large, oval-shaped openings at the crotch area, which remain unattached in the center. The legs are gathered at the cuffs and finished with a patterned decorative trim rendered in a darker blue at the hem. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with some minor spots and marks visible. The artist's signature, "Edith Skinner," appears in small, neat lettering in the bottom right corner.
title: Pantalette
